definition: Nasotracheal suctioning is a clinical procedure that removes airway secretions using suction through a catheter passed via the nose.
entry_text: Nasotracheal suctioning is a clinical procedure that removes airway secretions using suction through a catheter passed via the nose.
example: A trained clinician performs it when clinically indicated for a patient unable to clear secretions.
label: Nasotracheal suctioning
